note: Campus worlds made by others, shown with this site's own schools on the page at the site's root (PROGRESS.md, Decisions, A global collection of campus worlds). Edit by hand; `place` is written by `node scripts/worlds/geocode.ts`. Types and rules: src/worlds/worlds.ts.

worlds.title: Tsinghua World Model
worlds.about: An independent student project that lets you walk through Tsinghua University's campus and find courses and classrooms in it.

worlds.title: ZJU-LAPUTA
worlds.about: A 3D web adventure game set on Zhejiang University's Zijingang campus, along its real roads, with a robot lab where you take robots apart and put them back together.
worlds.noScreenshot: Its play page is on ModelScope, which loads a sign-in script and a captcha, so this site could not confirm that it opens without signing in. Its source code is public, and it runs on your own computer.

worlds.title: Westlake Campus Game
worlds.about: An unofficial 3D model of Westlake University's Yungu campus that several players can walk through together, find buildings in and plan walking routes across.
worlds.noScreenshot: It has no public address to play it at: its source code is public, and it runs on your own computer.
